title: The Public Record, Read Backwards
dek: Time is the spine. Chapters map the continuum: hour, day, week, month, year, era. Every sentence is meant to open a source.
body: This hour. The wire and the desk share a screen. External is labeled. TENET5 analysis is labeled.
This hour is not a feed — it is a spine tick on the continuum. Multi-source wires appear beside TENET5 desk claims; they never collapse into one voice.
EXTERNAL SOURCE means reported by another outlet — not a TENET5 verdict. Case claims still require primary documents you can open.
The day desk. Briefing, investigations, five-act argument, MAID file — four doors, one newsroom.
The day is the news desk: what Ottawa is doing, labeled inference, and open files.
Atmosphere film is memorial tone — not proof. LIRIL presents the station when you leave the page open; you still navigate.
Method · co-writers and SLATE. How the book is written under swarm co-writers and living SLATE.

Co-writers propose edits at sentence and paragraph grain; the author accepts or rejects. SLATE synchronization keeps design tokens and living projection aligned with the host reality lock. Runtime radix and weight schedule adjustments are living projections into p256 — proven only by timestamped artifacts, never by claim alone.
